verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Obsidian's file-based storage, plugin/API extensibility (Vault interface, community plugins), and Bases for database-like views, but nothing documents a bulk-operation capability (e.g., batch rename, bulk tag/metadata edit, multi-note transform) that an AI-native user could invoke across many items at once. The generic plugin API and 7,275-plugin ecosystem are extensibility building blocks, not evidence of a delivered bulk-operations feature.
